_note: Single source of truth for the dynamic forms. Each category (or subtype) lists its own spec fields, condition questions and accessory options, so no generic form is ever shown. 'ask' values: 'always' = user input; 'confirm_if_varies' = prefilled when the model has one value, asked when it has several or none (allow_unknown lets the user pick Unknown); 'only_if_missing' = taken from model data and never asked when known. 'show_if' hides a field until an earlier answer matches. Add a new category by appending an entry here; no template changes needed.
